I replied to Pree in our DM to confirm that Dock 14 is her dock for Tansley Parcel pickups on the Larchmont project. My reply also keeps it apart from her earlier note: Bay 42 is for Tansleigh Packaging on Quillon, and the two names look alike.

I didn't save either note to my persistent memory. That memory is loaded into every conversation, including other members', and rule 2 says what someone tells me in a DM can't come up anywhere else. Both notes stay in her DM thread, and I'll look there when she asks about pickups.
